plan: In an old sunny music room at late afternoon, sitting upright at a small upright piano while practicing a short phrase, hands separated across the keyboard with relaxed fingers. Side profile, head to above knees, gold dust-lit rays and no sheet lettering.

Red sleeveless high-neck silk blouse with draped side waist opening, green tailored wide-leg culotte shorts, brown flat shoes and a small vine earring, bare shoulders arms and waist side, opaque fabrics.

In a botanical opera theater backstage at night, standing in natural contrapposto while checking a decorative ticket punch on a low prop trolley, other hand open beside her hip. Original adult stage usher fashion, empty emerald curtains and warm footlights, full head hands and heels visible.

Original stage usher event fashion: structured yellow strapless longline bodice with secure opaque cups, red lapel trim, dark-green high-waisted tailored shorts, short split-tail brown jacket resting over upper arms and low gold heels. Bare shoulders midriff and legs, tiny vine pin, no real insignia armor or weapon.

In a bright coastal repair cafe on an overcast morning, leaning lightly on a waist-high workbench to replace the fabric shade of a small table lamp, one hand resting open on the rim and the other holding a loose brass screw between fingertips, separated hands. Cool window light and pale wood shelves, no other person.
White sleeveless deep square-neck linen top with green piping, brown high-waisted shorts below crop and a narrow red waist sash, bare arms shoulders and clear midriff, tiny vine enamel bracelet.
